adāru II

  • Meaning: "to be afraid (of), fear"

    • D: "frighten" OA, jB
    • Štn: iter. of Š O/jB

    • N: "become restless, worry about" OA, OB, jB
    • Ntn: iter. of N OA, OB, jB

ai I

alāku I

  • Meaning: "to go"
    • G: (illak, illik; perf. ittalak (cf. GAG §97n)) [DU]
    • Gtn: [DU.DU] "go, come repeatedly; roam about, wander", muttallik mūši [LÚ.GE6.A.DU.DU; (LÚ.)GE6.DU.DU] 'who walks around during the night' = "night-watchman"; OB of leg muscles "twitch persistently"
    • Gt: "go off, away" (cf. GAG §92e) differentiation between pret. of Gt and perf. of G difficult
    • Š: caus. of G [DU] with abstr. noun ending in -ūtu or adv. "make s.o./s.th. (become)" s.th.; stat. "is appropriate, suitable" [TÚM.MA]
  • Logograms: DU, IGI.DU, DU.DU
  • Lines: 14, 16a, 39, 79
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/al%C4%81ku%20I

ammīni I

  • Meaning: "why?";
  • Lines: 4b, 66
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/amm%C4%ABni%20I

amurru I

  • Meaning: "Amurru"
  • Logograms: , MAR.TU, IM.MAR.TU, IM.KUR.MAR, , MUL.MAR.TU
  • Lines: 56
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/amurru%20I

amāru I

  • Meaning: "to see"
    • G: (a/u) [IGI; IGI.DU8]
    • R: Mari
    • Gtn: iter. of G; Mari stat. "has learnt thoroughly"
    • Gt: jB "see from now on"?, mng. uncl.
    • D: rare; OA "examine" metal; cf. mummertu
    • Š: caus. of G
    • Št: "make s.o. meet" s.o.
    • N: pass. of G [IGI; IGI.LÁ]
    • Ntn: iter. of N 1
  • Logograms: IGI, IGI.DU8, IGI.LÁ
  • Lines: 4a, 21, 33a, 33b, 61, 69, 84
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/am%C4%81ru%20I

ana I

  • Meaning: (aš-š... etc.) "to, for" (freq. abbr. an, with assimilation of n to following consonant (OA often wr. a)) (prep., governs subst. in gen., pers. pron. in dat.) [from MB onwards DIŠ; O/MB occas. NAM; M/jB ŠÈ]
  • Logograms: DIŠ, NAM, ŠÈ
  • Lines: 3, 13b, 26, 27, 32, 38, 44b, 51, 55, 64, 65b, 67, 68b, 76, 77b
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ana%20I

anāku I

  • Meaning: "I; me" [Bogh. GÁ.E] as pred. freq. anākuma; OB ša anāku "as for me"; NB also acc. (to stress a pron. suff.), dat.
  • Logograms: GÁ.E
  • Lines: 38
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/an%C4%81ku%20I

apāru I

  • Meaning: "to cover the head" Bab., M/NA
    • G: (e/e, OB a/u) "put" crown, helmet etc. "on the head of" s.o. (= acc.), stat. "wears"; transf. of moon, star, king "be decked with" halo, radiance etc.; OB stat. of sheep's tongue "be covered, capped" ext.
    • Gtn: iter. of G, MA "constantly crown" king
    • Gt: stat. "is decked with"
    • D: "put headgear (= acc.) on head of" s.o. (= acc.)
    • N: "be crowned, covered"
  • Lines: 35
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ap%C4%81ru%20I

arhiš I

  • Meaning: "quickly, hastily" Ass., O/jB;
  • Lines: 53
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/arhi%C5%A1%20I

arāqu I

  • Meaning: "to be(come) green-yellow; pale"
    • G: (i/i; stat. (w)aruq, occas. uruq) [SIG7] "become green, yellow; pale" of face, invalid; of fluids, fruit, glass, star
    • Gtn: iter. of G [SIG7.SIG7; SIG7.MEŠ]
    • D: (OB lex. imper. burriq) fact. of G
    • Dt: pass. of D ?
    • Š: "gild" NA
    • N: "become yellow"
  • Logograms: SIG7, SIG7.SIG7, SIG7.MEŠ
  • Lines: 63, 66, 75
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ar%C4%81qu%20I

awû I

  • Meaning: "to speak"
    • G: (pret. īwu; stat. and 2 pers. sg. imper. awu) OA only
    • Gtn: iter. OA
    • Gt: (atwûm, later atmû) "speak" OA; O/jB(lit.) "discuss"; išti/itti X a. "negotiate with X"; ana X a. "tell X, speak to X"; OA "order (to do s.th.)"; jB itti libbīya (etc.) a. "think about" s.th.
  • Lines: 3, 32
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/aw%C3%BB%20I

ašābu I

  • Meaning: "to sit (down); dwell"
    • G: (Bab. a/i; imper. tišab, OA šib; OA stat. wašab, M/NA usbāku etc.; NA perf. ittūšib) [TUŠ; occas. TUŠ.A]
    • Gtn: iter. of G [TUŠ.TUŠ]
    • Gt: (cf. tašābu)
    • D: OB "settle" inhabitants; NB ~ "insert" s.th. (corrupt ?)
    • Š: caus. of G [TUŠ]
  • Logograms: TUŠ, TUŠ.A, TUŠ.TUŠ
  • Lines: 55, 56
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/a%C5%A1%C4%81bu%20I

aṣû I

  • Meaning: "to go out", + vent. "come out" (from = ina, ištu, acc.)
    • G: (perf. ittaṣi, NA ittūṣi) [È; MB in PNs also UD]
    • Gtn: iter. of G [È.MEŠ]
    • Gt: separative of G "go away (for good)"
    • Š: Mari
    • Štn: pass. of Š
    • Št2: "quarrel, pick a fight"
  • Logograms: È, UD, È.MEŠ
  • Lines: 35, 42
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/a%E1%B9%A3%C3%BB%20I

barāqu I

  • Meaning: "to lighten, shine" Bab.(lit.)
    • G: (i/i) [HI.HI] berqu + b. "lightning strikes"; of Adad "strike s.th. with lightning"; of eyes "flash"
    • D: jB stat. of woman "has flashing eyes?"
    • Štn: NB iter. of Š 2
    • Ntn: jB "flash, light up repeatedly", MB ptcp. ^d^Muttabriqu as name of demon
  • Logograms: HI.HI
  • Lines: 36
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/bar%C4%81qu%20I

belû II

  • Meaning: "to be extinguished, come to an end" O/jB, NA
    • G: (i/i) of fire, smoke; of oil-bubble "burst"; transf. of life, disease etc.
    • Gtn: iter., of brazier, torch
    • D: "extinguish" fire, disease, fever; "stop" quarrel, fight; "destroy" people, life etc.
  • Lines: 40
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/bel%C3%BB%20II

berqu I

  • Logograms: NIM.GÍR

būdu II

damāqu I

  • Meaning: "to be(come) good"

    • D: [SIG5]
    • Dtn: OB "continually make good"

dannu I

  • Meaning: NA f. also da''atu "strong, powerful, mighty, great" [KALAG(.GA)] of god, king, people, country; animal; of city, fortress, building, building material, implement, weapon, cloth; of mountain; "firm" of statement, command; OA ṭuppum dannum, MA dannutu "binding document"; "strong" of oath; "urgent" of business, message; "hard, difficult, severe" of terrain, weather, disease, distress, onslaught; "high" of prices; NA "big";
  • Logograms: KALAG KALAG.GA
  • Lines: 72, 74

danānu I

  • Logograms: KALAG
  • Lines: 8
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/dan%C4%81nu%20I

dekû II

  • Meaning: "to raise, shift" OAkk, Bab.
    • G: (e/e, i/i) [ZI]
    • D: "get s.o. moving, incite"
    • Š: OB, NB "have (troops) called up"; "incite" s.o., s.o.'s heart, to action
    • N: pass. "be called up"; "be disturbed"; NB of hands "be taken off" (ref. to inactivity)
  • Logograms: ZI
  • Lines: 4b, 83
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/dek%C3%BB%20II

didallu I

  • Meaning: "ash(es)" O/jB lex.;

  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/didallu%20I

edû II

  • Meaning: "to know" (M/NA cf. wadûm)
    • G: cf. wadûm
    • Š: "cause to know", "acquaint s.o. with s.th." (= acc.), abullam š. "show s.o. the city gate", i.e. confine to city; "make s.th. known, convey, make pronouncement"
    • Št: "inform oneself"?
    • ŠD: cf. wadûm
    • N: (ni/endû) "become acquainted"
  • Lines: 39, 81
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ed%C3%BB%20II

ekletu I

  • Meaning: (or iklētu(m)) "darkness" Bab. [KÚKKU]; bīt e. "dark chamber", "underworld";
  • Logograms: KÚKKU
  • Lines: 35, 42
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ekletu%20I

eli I

  • Meaning: "on, over, above; against; more than" OAkk, Bab., rarely NA [UGU] "on; on to" a place, a thing; of obligation etc. "on; on to" a person; of person "over" another, a task; "in addition to"; "more than" in quantity or quality; "against" enemy, person, esp. of anger, shout; "on account, on behalf of" s.o.; "to" s.o. after ṭiābu(m), marāṣu(m) "to please, displease";
  • Logograms: UGU
  • Lines: 19, 33b, 47
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/eli%20I

ellu I

  • Meaning: "pure; clear" [KÙ; SIKIL] "pure, clean" of water, oil; "bright, shining" of metal, stone; of mountains, forests, onions; "(cultically, ritually) pure" of deity, person, hands; of incantation, symbol; temple, place; of meal, offering, wine; e. as subst., desig. of priest; Bogh., Ug. "free" as social class;
  • Logograms: KÙ, SIKIL
  • Lines: 49
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ellu%20I

elû III

  • Meaning: "to go up, arise; (stat.) is high"
    • G: (i/i) [E11; jB also AN.TA]
    • Gtn: iter.
    • Gt: "go up and away"; of person, animal, silver, illness; O/jB ina X e. "forfeit X"
    • D: "make higher, raise" wall, building, 'head' (rēšu) of building; of deity "lift up, elevate" person, kingship (also with rēšu); "extol, praise (deity)"; NA "take away, remove"
    • Dtn: "repeatedly extol"
    • Š: [E11] caus. of G; jB ana zaqīpi š. "impale"; "post, install" garrison in fort etc.; Susa mê š. "have water close over one, be submerged" (in ordeal); "dedicate" to temple; "get out" from storage, kiln; "embark" person, goods; "bring forward" witnesses; "produce" lesion; "bring out, produce" tablet, lost property; "enter" on tablet; "introduce" bees to a region; "express" anxiety, thought; šum X š. "swear oath by X"; "disinherit" heir, "turn off, drive from" fields, land; "take" sheep from fold; "remove" boundary stone etc.; math. "subtract" [E11; NIM], "determine" root; Am. ša dama šūlû (desig. of gold)
    • Štn: iter. of Š
    • Št: jB of features in liver "be raised (as) high" as (= ana); Am. transf. of dowry "be made (as) immense as"
    • N: cf. ne'ellû
  • Logograms: E11,
  • Lines: 27
